serverIntro: Enter the address of your Securo server, the same one you open in the browser.
serverInvalid: Enter a web address, like securo.example.com.
serverUnreachable: Could not reach that address. Check it and your connection.
serverNotSecuro: That address does not look like a Securo server.
serverSsoOnly: This server only allows single sign-on and has not enabled it for the app. Ask its admin to set OIDC_NATIVE_REDIRECT_URIS=securo://oidc.
serverInsecure: This address is not encrypted (http). Use https:// for a server on the internet.
twoFactorIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

sso.failed: Single sign-on did not complete. Try again.

passkey.unsupported: This device cannot use passkeys. Android 9 or newer with a Google account or password manager is required.
passkey.noCredentials: No passkey for this server was found on this device. Add one from the website first, then try again.
passkey.notConfigured: This server does not trust the app for passkeys yet. Its admin needs to set WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME and WEBAUTHN_ANDROID_CERT_FINGERPRINTS.
passkey.insecureServer: Passkeys need the server on a domain name over HTTPS, not an IP address or plain http.
passkey.failed: The passkey sign-in did not complete. Try again.
passkey.rejected: This server did not accept that passkey.
